definitions.gloss: to wrap up, to envelop, to enfold
definitions.explanation: To completely wrap or enclose something, surrounding it entirely. Used both literally (wrapping an object) and figuratively (enveloping someone in warmth, kindness, or atmosphere).

examples.japanese: ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I wrapped my body up in a blanket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The mother gently enfolded her child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれて⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{見|み}えなかった→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The mountaintop was enveloped in fog and nothing was visible.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to wrap) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of wrapping thoroughly and completely, surrounding something on all sides. Frequently used in figurative/poetic descriptions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}む (to envelop with/in ~)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれる (to be enveloped in ~)
- ⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}む (to gently envelop)
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれる (to be bathed in light)
